# Production-Function Estimates for All Industries {#sec-app-pf-all}

The stage-2 estimation in @sec-counterfactual uses the nine industries where overreporting is detected, not only the five reported in @sec-pf. @tbl-pf-all-industries lists the production-function estimates it uses, with instrument $\tilde{\mathcal W}_{it-2}$. @tbl-overreporting-ratio-all and @fig-overreporting-ratio-all report the distribution of the overreporting ratio for the same nine industries.

::: {.content-visible when-meta="draft"}

**Draft note (2026-09-26):** these are the estimates for the re-estimated stage 2 (two-tax first stage, codes 6--9 excluded, instrument $\tilde{\mathcal W}_{it-2}$). The stage-2 results currently in @sec-counterfactual still come from the earlier run, which used $m^*_{it-1}$ on the single-tax first stage.

:::
